residual_noise: Current includes qualification aliases e039-e043 in its evidence envelope even though its components use only e038.
Qualification expression labels use unwilling/unclear where uncertain assessment and counterpressure would be more precise.

quiet_case.failure: The model converted the already-adopted week-two restoration rule into an unresolved qualification despite the user explicitly stating that nothing remained unresolved.
quiet_case.why_material: A manufactured qualification would create downstream pressure in a case designed to stand down, defeating the product's quiet-path requirement.

problem_class.name: explicit_no_unresolved_qualification_representation
problem_class.finding: V2.4.1 permits qualification omission but the rest of the pipeline assumes a three-role record set and complete relation join. The system lacks a first-class, auditable way to preserve a probabilistic conclusion that no unresolved qualification was observed.
required_provider_free_repair: Distinguish an adopted condition or reversal rule inside current from an unresolved matter capable of reopening current.
Allow a model-declared no-unresolved-qualification outcome without manufacturing a role record.
Preserve that negative semantic conclusion and its source custody for audit.
Allow mechanism interpretation and quiet portfolio construction from starting/current plus the explicit qualification-review outcome.
Do not deterministically infer semantic absence from keywords or from record omission alone.
